title: GIT-IN-CLOUDFLARE-1: the Worker keeps its working copy in Cloudflare's Git-compatible storage and mirrors to GitHub; deploy targets sit behind one provider interface
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** after ZERO-MINUTES-1 step 2 (Worker-native executor)
**Done check:** grep:ops/git-in-cloudflare-evidence.json::invocation_id
**Status:** open

Owner direction 2026-11-13: GitHub stays the master and public face; the loops need not depend on it; deploys may go to Cloudflare, AWS, GCP or GitHub. Unverified: what Cloudflare's Git-compatible storage supports (push, branches, size). Probe first: the Worker clones the repo into it, commits one change, pushes to the GitHub mirror; record result in ops/. Then add providers for deploy targets beside executor.js PROVIDERS. Practical Solutions bootstraps against the Worker loops, not Actions. Attempt 1 (pull request #403) was closed unmerged: its evidence file asserted clone, commit and push results from a probe whose imports do not exist. The evidence file must be the recorded output of a probe that ran (run id or Worker invocation id, timestamp, observed result per step), and every module the probe imports must be in the repository.
